Key audit matter:
(i) The application of IFRS 9 risk parameters i.e. probably
of default (PD), loss given at default (LGD) and
exposure at default (EAD) to trade receivables; and
(ii) The definition of default, determination of probability
of default matrix and identification of exposures with
significant deterioration in credit quality.
Disclosures on the application of IFRS 9 are set out in notes
2 and 4 of the financial statements.
